text: Speak in a dramatic fantasy narrator voice until your next turn.
Give the groom a dramatic 20-second fantasy RPG-style prophecy.
Do 10 push-ups before the next round.
The whole team must high-five every other team before play continues.
Sing the chorus of a song of the group's choosing.
One team member must act out their favorite movie scene in silence.
Take a shot (or a big sip) of your drink.
Talk in rhymes for the next 2 minutes.
Give a 15-second toast to the groom.
The team must swap seats/positions with another team for one round.
One team member must do their best dragon roar.
The team must invent and perform a two-line team battle cry.
One team member must balance a full cup on their head for 30 seconds.
The team must answer in whispers only until their next turn.
One team member must tell an embarrassing story about themselves (30 seconds).
The team must do a synchronized victory dance move, on command, for the rest of the game.
One team member must speak only in questions until their next turn.
The team must give a round of applause to the team currently in last place.
One team member must attempt to juggle two objects for 15 seconds.
The team must come up with a nickname for the groom and use it for the rest of the game.
One team member must do their best knight's bow to every other team.
The team must hold a 10-second dramatic gasp pose.
